retrievalProfile.description: A distressed, multi-layered collage featuring vertical oversized typography, a central landscape photograph, and chaotic geometric scribbles across high-contrast color blocks.

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tiered horizontal composition divided into cream, photographic, and black bands, unified by a massive vertical typographic element on the left and a dense web of thin, intersecting diagonal lines that create a sense of frantic energy and industrial decay.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical text anchoring the left third across all horizontal bands
Thin white/black scribbles creating a unified texture over disparate backgrounds
High-contrast grain in the central photographic strip
Color-coded typographic segments matching or contrasting the background bands

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central photographic strip occupies the middle third; oversized text dominates the left vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large vertical block letters on the left side.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the vertical text downward, then scans the horizontal photographic strip, finally caught in the web of diagonal lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The cream upper-right quadrant provides the only area of visual relief, though still textured with lines.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the cream top and black bottom.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are sliced by the horizontal band divisions
Texture of the background bleeds through the letterforms
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A smaller, cleaner version of the same font is used for secondary metadata at the top left.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary blocky, condensed skeleton for modification.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a three-band horizontal layout (cream top, grainy b/w landscape middle, black bottom). Overlay a dense web of thin, random diagonal lines across the entire canvas. Apply a heavy photocopy/grunge texture filter.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place oversized, ultra-condensed block text vertically on the left. The top segment should be dark grey, the middle segment should be textured with the background, and the bottom segment should be deep red. Apply a 'scratched' mask to the text to integrate it with the line web.

verificationChecks: Are there three distinct horizontal background bands?
Does the line web intersect both the background and the text?
Is the photographic element high-contrast and grainy?

adjustableVariables: Density of the diagonal line web
Color of the bottom typographic segment
mustRedesign: Identifiable human faces in the photograph
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite the heavy distressing.
Verify the line web feels chaotic but unified.
Check that the three horizontal bands are clearly defined.
Confirm the red accent provides a strong focal point at the bottom.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical Block Text + Horizontal Tri-Band + Chaotic Line Overlay + Photocopy Grain
